summary: Reduce 10 ENABLED Primary conversion actions to 3 real lead outcomes and demote 7 to Secondary. 7 operations. Bidding is unaffected in practice because all five campaigns run Maximize Clicks, but the Conversions column stops double-counting.
principle: Calls from ads and website calls are DIFFERENT lead sources and both stay Primary. What is removed is click-proxies, local actions and the WhatConverts uploads that re-report an event already counted.

before_state.observed_duplication: 2026-09-01, campaign 24132507747: WC Lead conversions=2.00 vs Ambient Cooling - LP -Submit Lead Forms conversions=1.00 on the same date and campaign

operations.name: Clicks to call
operations.reason: Clicks to call - MANY_PER_CLICK CONTACT. A click is not a completed call, and it double-counts both call actions.

operations.name: Local actions - Directions
operations.reason: Local actions - Directions - not a lead.

operations.name: Local actions - Website visits
operations.reason: Local actions - Website visits - not a lead.

operations.name: Local actions - Other engagements
operations.reason: Local actions - Other engagements - not a lead.

operations.name: Local actions - Menu views
operations.reason: Local actions - Menu views - not a lead.

operations.name: WC Lead
operations.reason: WC Lead - UPLOAD_CLICKS. Duplicates the website form action: on 2026-09-01 in campaign 24132507747 WC Lead recorded 2.00 while the WEBPAGE form action recorded 1.00 for the same day and campaign.

operations.name: WC Calls
operations.reason: WC Calls - UPLOAD_CALLS. Duplicates the two call actions above for the same physical call.

remains_primary.reason: Ambient Cooling - LP -Submit Lead Forms - the one canonical website form-lead action, WEBPAGE, ONE_PER_CLICK. This is the real form outcome.
Ambient Cooling - Lp - Phone call leads - WEBSITE_CALL, ONE_PER_CLICK. Measures a completed website-sourced call, a distinct lead source.
Calls from ads - AD_CALL, ONE_PER_CLICK. Measures a completed call placed from the call asset. A genuinely different lead source from a website call.

deduplication_requirements: Verify every imported action carries a transaction or lead id before it is ever restored to Primary.
Verify the website-call action's minimum call duration is a real qualification threshold, not 0 seconds.
Confirm counting_type ONE_PER_CLICK on all three retained Primary actions.
Confirm click-through and view-through windows are identical across the three.
sequencing: DO NOT EXECUTE until AMB-0915-LP-1 is deployed and the 24/24 attribution test passes. Changing conversion configuration while click ids are unreliable would re-baseline onto broken data.
historical_note: A conversion counted before a fix stays in the historical column forever. This plan does not and cannot restate history. A clean baseline starts on the execution date.
risk: MEDIUM - reporting changes immediately; bidding does not, because all five campaigns are Maximize Clicks and do not optimise to conversions.
rollback: Set primary_for_goal back to true on the same 7 action ids.
unrelated_resource_assertion: No conversion action is created, renamed, paused or removed. No counting_type, attribution model, lookback window or value setting is edited. No campaign goal override is touched. No WhatConverts configuration is changed.
